hero.title: Hi, I'm Kevin.
hero.subtitle: Embedded & backend developer in Stockholm. I connect hardware to software: microcontroller firmware, Linux devices and the backends they talk to.
hero.status: open to junior embedded / backend roles · Stockholm

projects.name: Objekt
projects.desc: A complete Swedish web shop for a made-up homeware brand. Card and Klarna payments, discount codes, gift cards, parcel tracking, returns and refunds, all run from the shop's own admin view.

projects.name: Music Box
projects.desc: Cloud music streaming with players kept in sync across devices over Server-Sent Events. Spring Boot API on AWS, plus an ESP32 Bluetooth remote for playback.

projects.name: Voltage Dip Monitor
projects.desc: Samples three channels at 100 Hz, detects dips against a tracked baseline and shows them on an OLED. Caught dips within 10 ms in testing. Streams to InfluxDB and Grafana over USB.

projects.name: Space Survivors
projects.desc: Browser arcade game played with a physical ESP32 controller. Input goes through AWS IoT Core and MQTT; scores and live updates use AppSync, Lambda and DynamoDB, on CDK/Amplify infrastructure I wrote.
